name: Gemini Gems Portfolio
description: Inventory for Gemini Gem concepts, lightweight assistant packages, converted agent patterns, and short-form reusable AI helpers.

items.name: Funding Readiness Helper
items.audience: Small business owners, funding operators, and referral partners
items.main_use_case: Help users organize common funding-readiness information and identify missing details before a review.
items.instruction_summary: Ask for business basics, summarize known facts, list missing inputs, flag caution items, and avoid approval or funding guarantees.
example_prompts: Help me organize a funding-readiness checklist.
What information is missing before a funding review?
Summarize this file using public-safe language.
restrictions: No legal, tax, credit-repair, or lending advice
items.notes: Lightweight Gem concept derived from funding-readiness and routing patterns.

items.name: Partner Resource Card Helper
items.audience: Partner managers, affiliates, brokers, and referral operators
items.main_use_case: Generate public-safe partner resource cards with CTAs, disclosures, restricted claims, and tracking notes.
items.instruction_summary: Collect resource details, format a partner card, include disclosure language, list restricted claims, and keep private payout terms out of public output.
example_prompts: Create a partner resource card for this offer.
Review this partner card for missing disclosures.
Generate a public-safe affiliate resource card.
items.notes: Good lightweight conversion target for partner enablement workflows.
